title: What makes a real old-time band: violin lead, old numbers
summary: Barnes says he would like to hear a real old-time band, with violin leading and old tunes such as Maple Leaf, instead of newer open-key numbers.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
